name: Hybrid search
summary: Combine keyword and semantic search with typo tolerance

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential for embedding the query. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: SEARCH_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Must match the model used at ingestion, or query and document vectors are not comparable.

env.name: SEARCH_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
env.description: Must match the ingestion model and the vector column width.

env.name: SEARCH_WEIGHT_VECTOR
env.description: Vector retriever weight. 0 disables it and skips the embedding call entirely.

env.name: SEARCH_WEIGHT_TRIGRAM
env.description: Trigram retriever weight. Lower by default because it is a typo fallback, not a primary signal.

env.name: SEARCH_RRF_K
env.description: RRF damping constant. 60 is the value from the original paper.

env.name: SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT
env.description: Results returned when the request does not specify.

env.name: SEARCH_LOG_QUERIES
env.description: Record queries for relevance tuning. Zero-result queries are the most actionable signal search produces.

operations.title: POST /click
operations.description: record a click, for relevance measurement
